[[File:Crystal shard detail.png|left|120px]]
'''Crystal shards''' are obtained from various activities in the [[Gauntlet]], and are used to create most pieces of equipment within the [[minigame]]. They will be automatically placed into the inventory when dropped by monsters or resources.

They can be ground with a [[Pestle and mortar (The Gauntlet)|pestle and mortar]] to receive 10 [[Crystal dust (The Gauntlet)|crystal dust]] each, which are an ingredient to create [[egniol potion]]s.

When inside the [[Corrupted Gauntlet]], [[corrupted shards]] are obtained instead.
